_context.title: Title of the dialog that shows how much every AI coworker of the workspace used: tokens, models and spend, per run.
_context.live: Badge next to the title: the numbers refresh on their own while the dialog is open.
_context.lessThan: An amount too small to show, such as "<$0.01". {amount} is already formatted.
_context.noPrice: Badge in place of a cost: the run used a model Rerun cannot price (a subscription billed by its provider, the customer's own API key, a custom endpoint). Never translate as "free".
_context.starter: Who started a run of a coworker: a person, another coworker, a schedule, a webhook, a check-in of the Chief of Staff, a job on a linked computer, the API.
_context.starter.many.unknown: Runs from before the app recorded who started them. Never charged to a person.
_context.kpi.vsPrevious: Change against the period of the same length just before. <muted> wraps the muted words.
_context.chart.before: In the pill over a bar: the value of the same slot in the previous period. <value> holds the formatted amount.
_context.chart.busiest: Header of the chart when nothing is hovered: the day (or hour, week) with the most usage. {label} is a date.
_context.chart.soFar: Header when hovering today: the day is not over. {label} is a date.
_context.coverage: Warning under the rankings about the runs whose cost or starter is unknown.
_context.model.subscription: A model used through a Claude or ChatGPT subscription, billed flat by its provider. {model} is the model name.

title: Usage
description: Tokens, models and spend of every coworker, as they run.
truncated: Only the most recent runs of this period are shown. Pick a shorter period to see them all.
noPriceHint: This model is billed by its provider (subscription, your own API key or a custom endpoint). {brand} counts its tokens but cannot price them.

sub.checkin: The Chief of Staff on its own
sub.job: A job ended on a computer

coverage.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# run used a model {brand} cannot price (subscription, your own key or a custom endpoint): its tokens are counted, its cost is left out.} other {# runs used a model {brand} cannot price (subscription, your own key or a custom endpoint): their tokens are counted, their cost is left out.}}
coverage.unattributed: {count, plural, one {# run has no recorded starter and is never charged to a person.} other {# runs have no recorded starter and are never charged to a person.}}

noEngine.title: No machine yet
noEngine.description: Usage shows up once the workspace's machine runs its first coworker.

unreachable.title: Usage is not available right now
unreachable.description: The workspace's machine did not answer. It refreshes on its own as soon as it is back.

outdated.title: Usage needs a newer machine
outdated.description: The workspace's machine runs an older version. Usage shows up once it is updated.
